name: Kichijouji Koi Iro Days
original_name: 吉祥寺 恋色デイズ
source:
You come back to your hometown after a 10 year absence and run into your childhood crush, who's now all grown up. Going to school together, talking about memories of the past…the two of you are getting closer day by day. 

You've known him forever. You were just kids before and he wasn't someone you could depend on. But now...could it be that you're falling for him?
